scope: Alpha absolute-error sums against a synthetic host-Mesa frame; MuPDF rasterizes SVG and PDF. No device parity.
recipe: Run the v4_crossing_export_control Rust test with SDOCX_INKPEN_CROSSING_EXPORT_DIR set to an existing empty directory. Decode rgba_zlib_base64 from inkpen-v4-crossing-native.json; reverse its 64 rows of 512 RGBA bytes. Open each SVG in PyMuPDF at scale 1 and each PDF at scale 4/3, with alpha=True. Assert 128x64 RGBA; sum absolute differences of the native and raster alpha bytes. Both exports strip the #fcfcfc page background and wrap the body in translate(0 64) scale(1 -1).
